title: 99% of People Are Prompting AI Wrong
description:
Most people write a prompt, run it once, and assume it's good.

That's a mistake.

The problem is that small changes to a prompt, model, or settings can completely change the output.

The best AI teams don't guess.

They test.

In this video, I break down a workflow using Braintrust to evaluate prompts against real-world examples so you can:

• Compare prompt versions
• Test changes before deployment
• Measure output quality
• Build more reliable AI applications

This is the same type of process used by teams building production AI products.

If you're building AI apps, agents, automations, or workflows, this is a skill worth learning.

Check the pinned comment for the full workflow.
